findings.severity: high (conditional on real Investec 200 shape, unverified until G2; a duplicate still needs a fresh human approval)
findings.issue: 'failed' (reservation released, not duplicate-guarded) is derived when no entry-level non-placeholder STRING PaymentReferenceNumber exists and a non-placeholder string ErrorMessage exists. So money-moved 200s are released and an identical instruction 60 min later reaches awaiting_approval: (a) PaymentReferenceNumber that is NOT a string (int 123456, list, dict) beside any ErrorMessage; (b) PaymentReferenceNumber at data level (not inside TransferResponses) beside an ErrorMessage; (c) differently-cased key (paymentReferenceNumber) beside an ErrorMessage; (d) success-flavoured ErrorMessage with no recognised ref: 'No error.', 'Success.', 'Payment processed successfully', 'N<ZWSP>/A'. Data-level ref WITHOUT error is correctly needs_review. Fuzz: 5.8k of 100k generated bodies were 'failed' with a non-string/data-level/nested reference present.
findings.fix: Until G2 verifies the shape: treat any non-empty, non-placeholder PaymentReferenceNumber of ANY type at data or entry level (case-insensitive key) as a reference; fold punctuation/zero-width and trailing '.' before placeholder compare and add 'no error occurred', 'processed', 'completed' wording; better, restrict 'failed'+release to 4xx PaymentRejected until the sandbox confirms an ErrorMessage-only 200 is a definite decline.
findings.repro: Env(live=True); env.client.responder=lambda:{'data':{'TransferResponses':[{'PaymentReferenceNumber':123456,'ErrorMessage':'warn'}]}} (or {'data':{'PaymentReferenceNumber':'P1','ErrorMessage':'warn','TransferResponses':[]}} or ErrorMessage 'Payment processed successfully'); approve + execute -> status failed reserved 0; second identical instruction +60min -> awaiting_approval. scratch: scratchpad/fz/dup.py, fz/fuzz.py

findings.issue: _JWT is quadratic on repeated 'eyJ' (greedy [A-Za-z0-9_-]{5,} then backtrack, restarted at every 'eyJ'). redact_secret_words / scrub_message are UNBOUNDED (scrub_message has no 2000 pre-cut): 'eyJ'*70000 (210KB) takes ~17s; '_' *200000 0.5s. sanitize_provider_message is safe (cut to 2000 first). Reachable only via str(exc) in the CLI error envelope.
findings.fix: Cut scrub_message input to ~2000-5000 chars before redact_secret_words, or make the JWT segments possessive/anchored with a lookahead for '.'.

findings.issue: Currency gate is a deny-list. Closed: USD/EUR/GBP spellings, full-width, ZWSP/soft-hyphen/word-joiner, 'U.S.D', 'U S D', 'R100 (about USD 5)', 'US dollars', adjacent-line 'USD'/'Currency: usd', image currency fields (USD, $, EUR, 'ZAR USD', full-width, Cyrillic, non-string, missing). Still read as ZAR (awaiting_approval, batch email shows ZAR): SEK, NOK, BRL, TRY, KES, PLN, KRW, RUB, kroner, bitcoin, quid, bucks, sterling, symbols (rouble sign, won, naira, shekel, lira, bitcoin sign), 'USDollar', 'USA', Cyrillic E in EUR, RTL-mark-reversed 'DSU', and a code split across newlines ('U\nS\nD'). Needs batch approval and the owner wrote the text.
findings.fix: Allow-list instead: accept only R / ZAR / rand adjacent to the figure and park any other alphabetic token or non-ASCII symbol on the same line.

findings.issue: Redaction gaps (provider text is only emailed to the verified owner, capped at 200 chars): not redacted xoxb-/xapp- Slack, ASIA... AWS session keys, rk_live_, whsec_, glpat-, SendGrid 'SG.x.y'; 'password is hunter22' redacts 'is' and leaks the value; keyword split by a newline ('ke\ny=ZZ') leaks. scrub_message (CLI envelope) does no NFKC / zero-width removal, so 'sec<ZWSP>ret=ZZ', full-width 'token=' and a configured secret with an inserted ZWSP survive; 'user:pass@host' is not redacted there. Configured secrets (any case, newline/space-split), JWT, AKIA, ghp_, sk-, bearer/basic, api_key/client_secret/pwd/passphrase, Authorization all ARE redacted.
findings.fix: Apply the same NFKC + Cf-drop prefold in scrub_message; add a few more vendor prefixes; skip filler words (is/was/=/:) after a secret word.

findings.issue: Mailbox preflight now folds NFKC, drops Cf, and rejects '', INBOX, INBOX./, INBOX:, INBOX.INBOX, INBOX/INBOX, quoted, full-width, ZWSP, BOM, NBSP, './INBOX', '../INBOX'. Still passes: 'INBOX\\' (backslash), modified UTF-7 '&AEkATgBCAE8AWA-', wildcards '*', '%', 'INBOX.*'. A conforming IMAP server rejects or does not select these as the inbox; fail-safe in practice.
findings.fix: Optional: decode modified UTF-7 and reject wildcard/backslash characters in the configured mailbox.

findings.issue: Bootstrap on an empty first beneficiary list (plan rule TA) is sound: an empty list establishes nobody, so every later payee is 'new' and held (hold hours); the error direction is MORE holds, never fewer. Verified: first cycle parks beneficiary_list_unavailable, bootstrap done, later payees held. Residual (inherent to TA): a first fetch that already contains an attacker-added payee establishes it.
